'''Liko's Armarouge''' (Japanese: '''リコのグレンアルマ''' ''Liko's Gurenarma'') is the first {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} [[Liko]] {{pkmn2|caught}} in the [[Paldea]] [[region]], and her fourth overall.

==History==
===As a [[wild Pokémon]]===
[[File:Liko catches Charcadet.png|250px|thumb|left|Charcadet joining Liko's [[party|team]]]]
{{p|Armarouge}} debuted as a {{p|Charcadet}} in ''[[HZ057|The Terapagos I Don't Know]]'', where it was seen living in the [[ruins]] of an ancient [[Paldea]]n fort in [[South Province (Area Three)]] alongside a {{p|Nacli}}. It quickly befriended [[Pagogo]], but eventually parted ways.

Over a year later, in ''[[HZ102|The Knight in the Ruins]]'', Charcadet reunited with Pagogo in the same ruins. Once it noticed some of its Pokémon friends were missing, Charcadet went looking for them with Pagogo accompanying it. Charcadet and Pagogo found its friends with [[Liko]], as it witness her protecting them from a [[Laquium]]-afflicted {{p|Scovillain}}. Seeing Scovillain about to attack Liko when she went to protect {{p|Happiny}}, Charcadet canceled out the attack by using {{m|Ember}} and decided to {{pkmn|battle}} the {{pkmn|category|Spicy Pepper Pokémon}}. Thanks to its {{a|Flash Fire}} [[Ability]], Charcadet was able to take in the opponent's {{type|Fire}} attacks and strike back with a boosted Ember, allowing Pagogo to intervene and purify the Laquium from Scovillain's body. Later, with the support of its friends, Charcadet chose to join Liko's team.
{{-}}

===With [[Liko]]===
[[File:Liko Armarouge and Amethio Ceruledge.png|thumb|250px|Armarouge and [[Amethio's Ceruledge]]]]
In ''[[HZ104|Charcadet's Wish]]'', Charcadet accompanied its Trainer to [[Amethio's mansion]] to search for clues regarding his whereabouts. Charcadet noticed a picture of [[Amethio]] and his Charcadet on a beach, which helped the group pinpoint his location. Charcadet was then used to battle [[Amethio's Ceruledge]], being overwhelmed by it throughout the battle. However, Charcadet bravely refused to give up and eventually landed a powerful Ember on its opponent, motivating Ceruledge to strike it down with {{m|Shadow Claw}}, before the battle was called off. In spite of the battle being over, Charcadet was eager to fight again, developing a rivalry with Ceruledge.
[[File:Liko Armarouge Flash Fire.png|250px|thumb|left|{{a|Flash Fire}} activating]]
In ''[[HZ108|Taking the Next Steps]]'', Charcadet and {{TP|Liko|Meowscarada}} were used in a [[Double Battle]] against [[Diana's Arcanine]] and {{form|Rotom|Wash}} {{p|Rotom}}. Using its Flash Fire Ability, Charcadet kept its ally protected by absorbing {{p|Arcanine}}'s Fire-type moves. Exploiting Charcadet's chivalry, [[Diana]] lured it into leaping in front of a {{m|Flare Blitz}}, then commanded Rotom to use {{m|Hydro Pump}}. Meowscarada moved Charcadet out of the way, but was left wide open in the process, allowing Arcanine to defeat her with another Flare Blitz. Diana lectured Charcadet for trying to protect its ally, only to end up needing to be saved and told it the importance of trusting its friends. Burning with determination, Charcadet continued the battle and successfully defeated Rotom, even learning {{m|Fire Spin}}, before getting overpowered and falling to Arcanine's {{m|Extreme Speed}}, making Diana the victor.
[[File:Liko Charcadet Auspicious Armor.png|thumb|250px|Charcadet wearing the Auspicious Armor it used to evolve]]
In ''[[HZ110|The Six Heroes Unleashed!]]'', Charcadet was used alongside the rest of Liko, [[Roy]], and [[Ult]]'s Pokémon to battle against five of the [[Six Heroes]], who were under the influence of the Super [[Strong Sphere]]s. Together, they stalled for time to allow Pagogo to purify the Laquium away from the heroes' bodies, but the [[Explorers]] used the Super Strong Spheres once more on them. In the [[HZ111|next episode]], despite its efforts, Charcadet was knocked out by {{TP|Lucius|Gouging Fire}}.

In ''[[HZ123|Mochi Mayhem!]]'', Charcadet received a set of [[Auspicious Armor]] from Diana. In the [[HZ124|next episode]], it was used alongside Amethio's Ceruledge to battle against [[Indi]] and [[Rubina]]'s two {{p|Salamence}}. Despite struggling at first due to wearing its newly obtained armor, Charcadet adapted by using new battle tactics and alongside Ceruledge managed to hold their own against the two Dragon Pokemon. In the climax of the battle, it eventually [[Evolution|evolved]] into {{p|Armarouge}}, learning {{m|Armor Cannon}} in the process and defeating the two Salamence, forcing Indi and Rubina to retreat. After the battle, Liko congratulated Armarouge on its Evolution before returning it to rest in its {{i|Poké Ball}}, as it was no condition to continue the mission.

In [[HZ127]], Armarouge battled against [[Ann]]'s {{p|Samurott}}. Both Pokémon were evenly matched and eventually {{Tera}}stallized, resulting in a series of attacks that knocked both of them out, resulting in a draw.

In [[HZ134]], Armarouge was sent out to battle the wild Pokémon that were affected by Laquium. However, Armarouge got hurt when it defended Meowscarada and {{TP|Liko|Hatterene}} from an attack by an {{p|Onix}} and a {{p|Gliscor}}, so Liko returned it to its Poké Ball to rest.

In [[HZ136]], Armarouge joined Liko, Meowscarada, and Hatterene in bidding Pagogo farewell when it decided to stay with the Six Heroes and [[White Zygarde|Zygarde]] to restore [[Laqua]], after the threat of Laquium was neutralized.
{{-}}

==Personality and characteristics==
[[File:Liko Party HZ136.png|thumb|left|250px|Armarouge with Liko, {{TP|Liko|Meowscarada}}, {{TP|Liko|Hatterene}}, and [[Pagogo]]]]
Armarouge is an honorable and headstrong Pokémon, though somewhat reckless and impulsive at times, but believes fighting fair in battle. As a {{p|Charcadet}}, it had a strong fighting spirit and was willing to face opponents stronger than itself, both traits typical of its species. On occasion, however, this would get the best of it, and it would try to jump into battles even if the situation was unproper, with {{p|Meowscarada}} often restraining it. In addition, it has a heroic spirit and has been shown to be willing to defend anyone from trouble, such as in ''[[HZ102|The Knight in the Ruins]]'', when it protected the Pokémon living in its home from {{OBP|Pepper|HZ102}}'s {{p|Scovillain}}. Armarouge even has a way of sensing potential danger to its friends, as seen in [[HZ124]], when it emerged from its {{i|Poké Ball}} on its own to protect Meowscarada and [[Dot's Quaxwell]] from getting attacked by [[Indi]] and [[Rubina]]'s {{p|Salamence}}. Overall, Armarouge is friendly to both people and Pokémon alike.

One of Armarouge's defining traits is its chivalry. When it chose [[Liko]] to be its [[Trainer]], it kneeled before her as if it was a knight, offering to protect her. Also, as a Charcadet, it had the habit of mounting on Pagogo's back akin to a knight riding a steed, something the {{pkmn|category|Tera Pokémon}} also seemed to enjoy. In fact, this led to them quickly forming a friendship, which later led to Pagogo encouraging Charcadet to join Liko's [[Party|team]]. However, its chivalrous nature can work against it and even be exploited, such as seen in ''[[HZ108|Taking the Next Steps]]'', when Charcadet tried to take on extra burdens and fight a [[Double Battle]] by itself, constantly trying to protect Meowscarada rather than trusting and working alongside her, which led to its teammate being defeated once their opponent thought to take advantage of this. After seeing the result of its actions and hearing [[Diana]]'s words, Charcadet learned to rely on its teammates more, and, in ''[[HZ118|Liko and Hattrem, Bonded by Happiness!]]'', was seen working together with Meowscarada and {{p|Hatterene}} to save a {{p|Ditto}}.
[[File:Liko and Armarouge.png|250px|thumb|Armarouge and Liko]]
Armarouge quickly formed an irreplaceable bond with Liko, having seen similarities of its own personality in her, such as their strong compassion and willingness to fight for others, which is what brought them together. As a result of this, Armarouge always gives its all for Liko, especially during [[Pokémon battle]]s. It strides to uphold the promise they made when it was {{pkmn2|caught}}, to protect Liko from danger and keep her safe. Through Liko and Pagogo, Armarouge became close friends with Meowscarada and Hatterene, even seeing them as its older sisters. However, upon witnessing Meowscarada and Hatterene's selflessness and skills in battle, Armarouge has come to admire them and consider them its mentors. It maintains its bond with its teammates after evolving. Armarouge's bond with Meowscarada and Hatterene has become an unbreakable one, putting their safety first before its own, as seen in [[HZ134]].

Since ''[[HZ104|Charcadet's Wish]]'', Armarouge has developed a rivalry with [[Amethio's Ceruledge]]; however, it also respects his battling skills and doesn't mind teaming up with him in battle, which led it to forming a friendship with the Fire Blades Pokémon. Armarouge has also shown high regard for other {{type|Fire}} Pokémon, such as [[Roy's Skeledirge]], as it looks up to him and has been seen sparring with the former, even [[HZ126|continuing doing so]] after evolving. Although, through their sparring and training battles, Armarouge has become very good friends with Skeledirge. Armarouge has a burning passion for battling, arguably more so than any Pokémon on Liko's team, and will battle any opponent, particularly other Fire types. In addition, Armarouge enjoys finding ways to become stronger and gets fired up with the idea, as seen in ''[[HZ111|Better, Farther, Stronger!]]''. Armarouge has shown to always be ready to train, even quickly finishing its food so it won't fall behind. After evolving, Armarouge has become much stronger in battle.
{{-}}

==Trivia==
* Armarouge is currently the only Pokémon owned by [[Liko]] that:
** Required an [[Evolution item]] to evolve.
** Is part of a two-stage or [[List of Pokémon with branched Evolutions|branched Evolution line]].
** Was caught post-time skip.
* Armarouge is the first {{type|Fire}} that isn't a [[first partner Pokémon]] to:
** Be owned by a female main character, not {{an|Lillie|counting}} [[SM078|temporary]] [[Ultra Beasts (anime)#Blacephalon|captures]].
** Have evolved under a main character's ownership other than {{Ash}}.
** Have evolved under a main character's ownership since [[Ash's Talonflame]], who evolved from {{p|Fletchinder}} in ''[[XY086|A Legendary Photo Op!]]'', 471 episodes earlier.
* Armarouge is the first Pokémon owned by a female main character to:
** Be an officially owned Fire type since [[Serena's Delphox]], who was obtained as a {{p|Fennekin}} in ''[[XY004|A Shockingly Cheeky Friendship!]]'', 531 episodes earlier.
*** It is also the first Fire type owned by a female main character to evolve on-screen since {{an|Serena}}'s Delphox as well, having evolved from Fennekin into Braixen in ''[[XY064|Battling with Elegance and a Big Smile!]]'', 493 episodes earlier.
** Have used an Evolution item to evolve since [[Misty's Politoed]], who evolved from {{p|Poliwhirl}} by using a [[King's Rock]] in ''[[EP247|Outrageous Fortunes]]'', 1,109 episodes earlier.
* Amongst the Pokémon owned by the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]], Armarouge and [[Roy's Skeledirge]] are the only ones known to share a {{Tera|Tera Type}}.
* Unlike with other Pokémon, {{p|Charcadet}} did not glow during its [[Evolution]] sequence; the [[Auspicious Armor]] did, instead.
